visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit sports gymnasium with smooth yellow walls and rows of light blue plastic seating, a woman with long, light brown hair and a black tank top films herself in a selfie perspective. She is accompanied by a dark-haired companion wearing a white mesh sports jersey and black shorts. (2) The woman in the background stands up and pulls her white jersey over her head, revealing a pink sports bra. The foreground narrator reacts with a shocked facial expression, wide eyes, and an open mouth, eventually covering her face with her hand in a gesture of disbelief. (3) The camera focuses on the friend as she produces a black sports bra and begins putting it on over her existing one while seated in the public area. Her hands are visible as she adjusts the elastic band and straps. The background shows a badminton court with distant players in red and black attire. (4) Both women are seen together again in the frame. The narrator continues to look at the camera with an amused, surprised expression, while the friend, now wearing the new black sports bra, looks toward the lens and makes a peace sign gesture. The indoor lighting remains bright and even throughout the sequence.
